market_definition: The acrylic emulsion adhesives market comprises water-based, non-tacky or low-tack adhesives made from acrylic polymer dispersions for laminating and bonding. It measures sales of finished adhesives excluding permanently tacky pressure-sensitive grades. BY POLYMER TYPE: Pure Acrylic, Styrene-Acrylic, Other Acrylic Copolymers. BY APPLICATION METHOD: Roller / Laminating, Spray, Brush & Trowel. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Flexible Packaging Lamination, Building & Construction, Automotive Interiors, Textiles & Nonwovens, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesives; structural acrylic adhesives; acrylic emulsions for paints and coatings. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
